title: Warm Dense German Chocolate Brownies
description: Rich and decadent brownies featuring plain and tempered chocolate, perfect for a vegetarian dessert
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Melt the plain dark chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Whisk together the sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract in a large bowl.
Add the flour, cocoa powder, and salt to the bowl and whisk until just combined.
Pour in the melted chocolate and whisk until smooth.
Pour the batter into a greased and floured 8-inch square baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs attached.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 10 minutes.
Melt the tempered chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Pour the melted tempered chocolate over the warm brownies and smooth the top.
